summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Goldman Sachs MarketBeta U.S. Equity ETF (GSUS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of US equities selected and weighted by market capitalization. GSUS was launched on May 12, 2020 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.
infoTable: Solactive GBS United States Large & Mid Cap Index

holdings.infoBox: GSUS is an equity ETF with a total of 407 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.08%, Apple at 7.40%, Alphabet at 5.89%, Microsoft at 5.61%, and Amazon.com at 3.79%.
